exact_claim: Stim simulates stabilizer circuits with Pauli noise; this experiment does not simulate arbitrary non-Clifford quantum computation.
The decoder input is a vector of detection-event bits; the target is a logical-observable flip, not a unique physical error chain.
This study uses a rotated distance-3 Z-basis memory with three measurement rounds and a 24-element detector vector.
The neural classifier has 1,345 parameters and outputs a probability for observable 0 being flipped.
For the preselected seed-101 model, prediction error rises from 78/20,000 at measurement noise 0.005 to 732/20,000 at 0.03.
The seed-101 Brier score rises from approximately 0.00337 at measurement noise 0.005 to 0.03102 at 0.03.
Matched-prior MWPM uses the evaluation noise model; fixed-prior MWPM retains the training noise model.
The seed-101 neural model has more observed failures than matched-prior MWPM at each of the four evaluated settings.
verification_status: verified aggregate comparison; no significance claim

exact_claim: A model trained under one noise distribution may become less reliable when measurement noise changes.
verification_status: motivating hypothesis; limited evidence in this bounded run

exact_claim: These results are classical simulation and classical machine learning, and are not evidence of quantum advantage or hardware real-time decoding.
The starting AlphaQubit and near-term neural-decoder papers have not been independently read in this network-constrained session.
Brier score includes both calibration and discrimination; an increase alone does not isolate a calibration defect.
The supplementary paired-outcome tables compare decoders on the same final test shots, without treating decoder errors as independent samples.
Calibration-bin intervals in the supplement are pointwise 95% Wilson intervals for observed flip frequency, not simultaneous confidence bands or uncertainty in the model probabilities.
In a separate fresh-shot confirmation, the frozen seed101 model made 390/100,000 errors at measurement noise 0.005 and 3,796/100,000 at 0.03.
The confirmation uses the unchanged fitted seed101 model on disjoint fresh test streams; it improves conditional test precision without replicating model training.
